ENGR 407 / EXPERIENTIAL LEARNING

GameDay Ventures.

The assignment: design, build, and test an original tailgate game.

Teams take their prototypes to the GameDay Ventures event, where games are played and judged. It connects product development with user feedback, teamwork, and a very Penn State setting.

FROM CLASS PROJECT TO STUDENT VENTURE

Meet Whirl Pong.

Onward State profiled mechanical engineering student Dillon Fink in September 2024. His participation in GameDay Ventures helped spark the idea for Whirl Pong, a new take on a familiar tailgate game. The Daily Collegian also covered his entrepreneurial journey in January 2025.
